shellCommands.command: ls && cat package.json && echo "---PAGE---" && cat app/page.tsx 2>/dev/null && echo "---API---" && ls lib/ 2>/dev/null && cat lib/api.ts 2>/dev/null
cat next.config.ts && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "---APPDIR---" && ls -R app __agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null | head -50

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo "---VER---"; node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/node_modules/next/package.json').version)"; echo "---CACHELIFE---"; grep -rn "cacheLife\|cacheComponents\|dynamicIO" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "hours" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/cache-handlers/*.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/lib/*.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== profiles ==="; grep -rln "revalidate: 3600\|expire: 86400" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head
git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
git checkout tsconfig.json && ls -a | grep -i gitignore || echo "NO .gitignore"
rm -f /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && echo "=== FINAL DIFF ===" && git diff app/page.tsx next.config.ts
